policy.compiler: Verify wood.lock when present; optional final --locked requires a project and lock
policy.inventory: Read-only deps-compatible JSON; verifies lock only with --locked
policy.inspection: frontend.load, body_semantics.load and existing inspection tools do not verify locks

pinned: exact captured manifest bytes for all packages
every transitive dependency .wd source, including unused modules
compiler language version and relative dependency graph
not_pinned: native libraries, headers and C++ toolchain

compatibility.manifest_snapshot: Package and Result record layouts unchanged; project.resolve retains required-entry behavior
compatibility.loaded_bytes: Verify module.source, never a fresh disk read; configuration uses captured manifest resolution
compatibility.existing_output: guarded; not an atomic exclusive create

limitations: No hosted lock writer or general production-driver command parity
Entry traversal budget is an additional hosted bound; production limits .wd files but not nonsource entries
No filesystem transaction against concurrent hostile changes
